# ThkTree 项目全面分析报告

## 1. 项目介绍

### 项目概述
ThkTree 是一个基于 Flutter 构建的本地优先树形 LLM 对话应用。该项目采用"代码即文档"的理念，将数据存储、状态管理和用户界面完全以代码形式呈现，便于 AI 代理协作开发。

### 核心目标
- **本地优先**：所有数据以 Markdown 文件存储，确保数据可读性和可移植性
- **树形对话**：支持多主题、多层级会话树，每个节点代表独立对话线程
- **可控上下文**：通过祖先总结机制控制上下文长度，平衡 token 限制与语义完整性
- **笔记联动**：支持从对话摘录笔记，笔记可作为新对话的起点

### 目标用户
- 需要结构化思考的个人用户
- 希望将对话内容转化为可读文档的开发者
- 追求数据主权和隐私保护的用户

## 2. 技术架构

### 整体架构设计

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[ThkTreeApp] --> B[Router Layer]
    A --> C[State Management]
    A --> D[UI Layer]
    
    B --> E[GoRouter]
    C --> F[Riverpod Providers]
    D --> G[Material 3 UI]
    
    F --> H[Domain Layer]
    F --> I[Data Layer]
    F --> J[UI Features]
    
    H --> K[Entities]
    H --> L[Use Cases]
    
    I --> M[Storage]
    I --> N[Index]
    I --> O[LLM Integration]
    
    M --> P[File System]
    N --> Q[SQLite]
    O --> R[DeepSeek API]
```

### 模块化组织

```mermaid
graph LR
    subgraph "Domain Layer"
        A1[entities] --> A2[node.dart]
        A1 --> A3[ids]
        A1 --> A4[errors]
    end
    
    subgraph "Data Layer"
        B1[storage] --> B2[fs_layout]
        B1 --> B3[md_parser]
        B1 --> B4[md_writer]
        B1 --> B5[meta_json]
        
        B6[index] --> B7[sqlite]
        B6 --> B8[reindex]
        B6 --> B9[search]
        
        B10[llm] --> B11[deepseek_client]
        B10 --> B12[prompt_builder]
        B10 --> B13[streaming_controller]
    end
    
    subgraph "UI Layer"
        C1[screens] --> C2[Theme List]
        C1 --> C3[Chat Screen]
        C1 --> C4[Notes]
        C1 --> C5[Settings]
        
        C6[router] --> C7[go_router]
    end
    
    subgraph "State Layer"
        D1[state] --> D2[Riverpod Providers]
    end
```

## 3. 核心实现

### 应用入口点
应用程序从 `lib/main.dart` 启动，采用依赖注入模式初始化核心服务：

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Main as main.dart
    participant Paths as AppPaths
    participant Logger as AppLogger
    participant Store as SettingsStore
    participant App as ThkTreeApp
    
    Main->>+Paths: load()
    Paths-->>-Main: paths
    Main->>+Logger: init()
    Logger-->>-Main: logger
    Main->>+Store: load()
    Store-->>-Main: settings
    Main->>+App: runApp()
    App-->>-Main: Material App
```

### 路由架构
使用 `go_router` 实现复杂的多分支路由系统：

```mermaid
graph TD
    Root[/] --> Themes[Themes Branch]
    Root --> Notes[Notes Branch]
    Root --> Settings[Settings Screen]
    
    Themes --> ThemeList[/themes]
    Themes --> ThemeDetail[/themes/:themeId/tree]
    Themes --> ChatNode[/themes/:themeId/nodes/:nodeId]
    Themes --> SummaryNode[/themes/:themeId/nodes/:parentNodeId/summary]
    
    Notes --> NoteBrowse[/notes]
    
    subgraph "Bottom Navigation"
        T1[Theme Tree]
        T2[Notes]
    end
```

### 数据模型设计

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class NodeEntity {
        +String themeId
        +String nodeId
        +String? parentId
        +NodeKind kind
        +String title
        +String createdAtUtcIso8601
        +String updatedAtUtcIso8601
    }
    
    class NodeKind {
        <<enumeration>>
        +chat
        +summary
    }
    
    class AppSettings {
        +LlmProvider llmProvider
        +String apiKey
        +String model
        +String? localeLanguageCode
        +copyWith()
    }
    
    class LlmProvider {
        <<enumeration>>
        +deepseek
        +openai
        +claude
        +gemini
        +minimax
        +kimi
    }
    
    NodeEntity --> NodeKind
    AppSettings --> LlmProvider
```

### 状态管理模式
采用 Riverpod 实现响应式状态管理：

```mermaid
graph LR
    A[UI Components] --> B[ConsumerWidgets]
    B --> C[Providers]
    C --> D[AsyncData States]
    D --> E[UI Updates]
    
    subgraph "Provider Types"
        F[State Notifiers]
        G[Async Selectors]
        H[Future Providers]
    end
    
    C --> F
    C --> G
    C --> H
```

### 存储架构

```mermaid
erDiagram
    THEME ||--o{ NODE : contains
    NODE ||--o{ MESSAGE : has
    NOTE ||--|| NODE : references
    NODE ||--o{ NOTE : spawns
    
    THEME {
        string themeId PK
        string title
        datetime createdAt
        datetime updatedAt
    }
    
    NODE {
        string nodeId PK
        string themeId FK
        string? parentId
        enum kind
        string title
        datetime createdAt
        datetime updatedAt
    }
    
    MESSAGE {
        string msgId PK
        string nodeId FK
        enum role
        string body
        datetime createdAt
        datetime updatedAt
    }
    
    NOTE {
        string noteId PK
        string themeId FK
        string sourceNodeId
        string spawnedNodeId
        datetime createdAt
        datetime updatedAt
    }
```

## 4. 关键特性

### 流式对话处理

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> BeginSend
    BeginSend --> BeginStream: Send User Message
    BeginStream --> OnToken: Receive Streaming
    OnToken --> OnToken: Continue Streaming
    OnToken --> EndStreamSuccess: Stream Complete
    OnToken --> EndStreamError: Stream Failed
    
    EndStreamSuccess --> [*]
    EndStreamError --> [*]
    
    state BeginStream {
        [*] --> Streaming
        Streaming --> PreviewUpdate: Update Preview
        PreviewUpdate --> Streaming
    }
```

### 上下文总结机制

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Ancestor Messages] --> B[DeepSeek Summary]
    B --> C[User Review]
    C --> D[Approved Context]
    D --> E[Child Node Chat]
    
    F[New Message Added] --> G[Mark Summary Stale]
    G --> H[Show Warning]
    H --> I[Regenerate Summary]
```

### 笔记系统集成

```mermaid
graph LR
    A[Chat Message] --> B[Select Text]
    B --> C[Create Note]
    C --> D[Add to Note]
    
    E[Note Detail] --> F[Start New Chat]
    E --> G[Insert into Current Chat]
    
    F --> H[Compose First Message]
    G --> I[Pre-fill Input]
```

### 设置管理

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class SettingsStore {
        +load() AppSettings
        +saveProvider(provider)
        +saveApiKey(provider, key)
        +saveModel(provider, model)
        +saveLocale(languageCode)
    }
    
    class AppSettings {
        +LlmProvider llmProvider
        +String apiKey
        +String model
        +String? localeLanguageCode
        +get apiKey()
        +get model()
    }
    
    SettingsStore --> AppSettings
```

## 5. 项目特色

### 本地优先设计
- **纯文本存储**：所有数据以 Markdown 文件存储，确保长期可读性
- **SQLite 索引**：仅作为检索加速，可随时重建
- **安全存储**：敏感信息使用 `flutter_secure_storage`

### 并发控制
- **单写者原则**：每个节点的 `session.md` 同时只有一个写入流程
- **原子操作**：使用临时文件 + `rename` 确保写入原子性
- **流式中间态**：通过 `<!-- streaming -->` 标记处理流式写入

### 错误处理
- **流式错误恢复**：断流后可恢复，错误状态保留在文件中
- **重试机制**：支持重新生成失败的响应
- **索引重建**：支持从磁盘重建 SQLite 索引

## 6. 总结与建议

### 架构优势
1. **清晰的模块边界**：遵循领域驱动设计原则
2. **可扩展的状态管理**：Riverpod 提供灵活的状态组织
3. **强大的工具链**：完整的开发工具和测试框架
4. **AI 友好**：代码即文档，便于 Agent 协作

### 改进建议
1. **性能优化**：考虑实现消息预览缓存
2. **国际化**：完善多语言支持
3. **备份机制**：虽然 MVP 不做，但可考虑未来扩展
4. **测试覆盖率**：增加单元测试和集成测试

### 技术债务
- 部分异步操作缺少完善的错误处理
- 某些 UI 组件可以进一步解耦
- 日志系统的远程记录功能有待完善

ThkTree 项目展现了现代 Flutter 应用的最佳实践，通过清晰的架构设计和完善的工具链，为 AI 代理协作开发提供了优秀的样板工程。
